name: services.linn/msd
title: Primer Market Systems (MSD) & DCED Engine
description: MSD/M4P tools: DCED math, dealer deals, 2,523 evidence guides, and live donor RFPs.

tools.name: search_msd_knowledge
tools.description: Search Primer International's global Market Systems Development (MSD / M4P) and Social Enterprise database (2,523 records across DCED, BEAM Exchange, MSD4E, SEWF, ILO The Lab, ANDE, WEF Schwab Foundation, and UN ESCAP).

query.description: Search keywords or concepts (e.g., cost-share agreement, thin market mechanics, social procurement, work integration).

limit.description: Maximum number of evidence matches to return (1-20).

tools.name: calculate_deal
tools.description: Calculate rural retail dealer unit economics, monthly working capital requirements, currency inflation decay, and smallholder payback periods for private sector co-investments.

retail_price.description: Customer retail price at rural shop ($).

monthly_volume_units.description: Estimated monthly units sold per dealer.

dealer_fixed_cost_monthly.description: Dealer monthly overhead for shop rent, staff, power ($).

cash_cycle_days.description: Days from inventory purchase to customer cash collection (7 to 14 benchmark).

farmer_seasonal_revenue_gain.description: Net smallholder income gain per harvest season ($).

tools.name: calculate_dced_attribution
tools.description: Calculate DCED-compliant attributable Net Additional Income (NAI), deadweight, displacement, substitution, systemic copycat crowding-in, and full-time equivalent (FTE) employment.

gross_additional_income_per_beneficiary.description: Annual gross income increase per adopter ($/yr).

deadweight_pct.description: Adoption percentage that would have occurred without the project (0-100%).

displacement_pct.description: Income gains displacing existing local businesses (0-100%).

substitution_pct.description: Forgone income from abandoned alternative crops (0-100%).

crowding_in_multiplier.description: Ratio capturing competitor imitation (1.0 = none, 1.25 = 25% copycat expansion).

direct_partner_jobs_created.description: Salaried jobs created by commercial lead firm.

additional_labor_days_per_beneficiary.description: Extra casual on-farm labor days demanded per year.

program_intervention_cost.description: Total donor budget allocated to intervention ($).

working_days_per_fte.description: Benchmark workdays per full-time equivalent job.

tools.name: lint_proposal
tools.description: Audit proposal text against core Market Systems Development (MSD) rules: detects direct asset handouts, missing partner matching funds, unadjusted 100% attribution claims, and vulnerable exchange rate pegs.

text.description: Draft proposal or terms of reference text to audit.

tools.name: search_opportunities
tools.description: Search active, future-closing Market Systems Development (MSD), value chain, financial inclusion, and social enterprise RFPs, EOIs, grants, and consultancies aggregated from UNGM, UNDP, ReliefWeb, EU TED, and FinDev Gateway.

query.description: Optional keywords (e.g., climate microfinance, incubator, Cambodia, MSME, FAO).

category.description: Filter by Market Systems or Social Enterprise practice category.

contract_type.description: Filter by contract type or solicitation format (preferred alias for modality).

donor.description: Filter by issuing agency or organization (e.g., UNDP, UNOPS, FAO, ITC, UNIDO, SNV).

eligibility.description: Filter by vendor eligibility (International Open vs Local Vendors Only).

max_days_left.description: Maximum days remaining until closing deadline (1-365).

limit.description: Maximum number of active opportunities to return (1-25).

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.description: Retrieve complete structured metadata and official links for a single active MSD or Social Enterprise opportunity by numeric ID.

id.description: Numeric opportunity ID returned by search_opportunities.
